segments.title: Hype Train Theme Recording Session
segments.notes: Pepito delivers cold open; Case oversees Hype Train's creation of new official theme 'Training Montage' over Eye of the Tiger instrumental, with Mick from Rocky consulted.

segments.title: Stargate AI Initiative & Musk Feud

segments.title: Park Opinions: Scents, Ghosts, and Moon Men
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein interviews park visitors: scent guru Jam Womans, demon-form Mick from Rocky, sun-yeller Bradfordshire, tree/ground enthusiast Donny Dangler, Stargate movie villain, Goa'uld worrier Billy Bob, hamster Pete the Ann Pete, middle-finger defender, TikTok black-market user, Jeb's dad claiming wood entrapment, park ranger reporting Peter Gibbon, Moon-man popper-seller Mountain Man Mark.

segments.title: Bryan Johnson's Son Erection Data
segments.notes: Liliana joins Case to dissect biohacker Bryan Johnson posting his 19-year-old son Talmage's nocturnal erection metrics (duration, quality, frequency) alongside his own; trigenerational plasma exchange with grandfather revealed.

segments.title: Viewer Videos: Three Dads, Ed Sheeran, Knife Tricks, Roseanne, Disco Horse
segments.notes: Case and Leon rate submissions: polyamorous three-dads reality teaser, Ed Sheeran impressionist, ping-pong ball knife trick, Roseanne clip (0.17), disco horse TikTok (8.41), Resident Evil Coca-Cola placement.

segments.title: Musk Nazi, Logan Paul Paternity, Gorilla Debt
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate Elon Musk's salute, Crum's alleged fatherhood of Logan Paul (poll created), and Crum's $179K debt to Rock-afire gorilla; Munch pays Crum $5K consolation after Crum denies paternity but admits ages 'could line up.'

segments.title: Kendall's Performance Review & Pay Equity
segments.notes: Kendall walks through studio, reveals management cited 'attitude problem' for noting her role is underpaid vs peers; discusses agency title manipulation (content creator vs producer) to suppress wages.

segments.title: Trailer Watch: Zero Day, Bloat, Emilia Perez, Millennium
segments.notes: Case and Leon (as Chris and Trent) watch Netflix's Zero Day (De Niro), Japanese horror Bloat (kappa folklore), awards contender Emilia Perez, and 1989 time-travel thriller Millennium.

segments.title: Sign-off & Sunday Gaming Tease
segments.notes: Case closes three-hour broadcast, rates Psychor/Dank Sauce, notes Asmongold 50K viewers, teases Sunday gaming stream with Chris and Trent.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News opened with Hype Train recording its permanent 'Training Montage' theme before Case Blackwell and Jeff Ripple dissected Trump's $500B Stargate AI initiative, the Musk-Altman feud, Musk's Nazi salute, and his PoE2 account-boosting admission. Trip Bradstein's park interviews spiraled through scent gurus, a demonic Mick from Rocky, a tree-fornicator, a Stargate villain, Jeb's wood-trapped father, a Peter Gibbon sighting, and a Moon-man popper salesman. Liliana joined for biohacker Bryan Johnson's son's erection data, Leon co-hosted Amongst the Web video ratings, and Munch & Crum debated Musk, Logan Paul paternity, and Crum's $179K gorilla debt — ending with Munch paying Crum a $5K consolation. Kendall appeared to expose her workplace pay-equity retaliation, and the broadcast closed with Case and Leon watching Zero Day, Bloat, Emilia Perez, and Millennium trailers.
